title: Talking Through The Iron Gates — Part 4

series.summary: Hakari's daydream of a wedding gives way to a silent mansion, a locked gate, and a phone call that ends when a hand lands on her shoulder.

segments.voiceover_text: She pictures a veil, falling petals, and a white suit standing beside her on a hilltop. The daydream is finished down to the guests.
Reality is a hushed mansion instead. Rentaro shrugs on a jacket, walks an empty hallway, and a woman in black is already waiting.
He ends up outside tall iron gates, waving up from the pavement. Inside the glass, Hakari presses one finger to her lips.
They talk through the bars on their phones. Then a hand closes around her shoulder from behind, and her voice stops mid-sentence.
